title: Fun Vehicles for Kids! Monster Truck, Race Car and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're meeting five super fun vehicles.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Some are big, some are fast, and one even plays music! Let's find out.

lines: Here's our first stop. Here's a clue: it plays a happy song and sells cold treats! Can you guess?
An ice cream truck is like a little shop on wheels.
It plays a song so everyone knows it's coming.
Treats are passed out of a little window on the side.
Can you hum a happy song? La la la!
Can you guess how the ice cream stays cold?
A big freezer inside keeps it cold and frosty!
Let's say it together: ICE CREAM TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: ICE CREAM TRUCK!
We always wait on the sidewalk with a grown-up for a treat.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has the biggest tires you've ever seen! Can you guess?
A monster truck is a pickup truck with giant wheels.
One tire can be as tall as a grown-up!
Monster trucks drive at shows, with big jumps for the crowd.
Can you bounce like a monster truck? Boing, boing!
Can you guess how it lands so softly after a jump?
Let's say it together: MONSTER TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: MONSTER TRUCK!
The drivers wear helmets and seat belts at every show.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's low and fast, and it zooms around a track! Can you guess?
A race car is built to go really, really fast.
It zooms around and around the race track.
It sits low and wide, so it hugs the road on the turns.
Can you zoom in place? Ready, set, go!
Can you guess what the checkered flag means?
It means the race is finished! Hooray!
Let's say it together: RACE CAR!
One more time, nice and loud: RACE CAR!
At a pit stop, a team can change all four tires in just a few seconds.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's like a tiny house on wheels! Can you guess?
A camper van takes families on fun trips.
Some campers have a roof that pops up for more room.
Inside, there can be a bed and a tiny kitchen.
Can you pretend to sleep? Shh... snore, snore!
Can you guess where camper vans like to stop at night?
At campgrounds, under the moon and stars!
Let's say it together: CAMPER VAN!
One more time, nice and loud: CAMPER VAN!
In the morning, it's time to drive to a new place.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it has two wheels and two pedals! Can you guess?
A bicycle is a vehicle you power with your legs.
When you push the pedals, a chain turns the back wheel.
The handlebars help you steer left and right.
Can you pedal your legs in the air? Round and round!
Can you guess what the little bell is for?
Ring, ring! It tells people you're coming!
One more time, nice and loud: BICYCLE!
Always wear a helmet when you ride a bike.

recap: That was so much fun! Let's remember.
The ice cream truck has a big freezer inside.
The monster truck has bouncy shocks.
The checkered flag means the race is finished.
The camper van stops at campgrounds at night.
And the bike bell goes ring, ring!
outro: Which fun vehicle was your favorite? Be kind, and take turns when you play.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
